definitions.explanation: A licensed professional who cares for and educates young children at nursery schools and daycare facilities. This is an official qualification requiring a national exam in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保育士|ほいくし}です。
examples.english: My older sister is a nursery teacher.

examples.japanese: {保育士|ほいくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}りたい→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I want to get a nursery teacher qualification.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{保育士|ほいくし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{待機|たいき}{児童|じどう}→待機児童：08624_taikijidou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: There is a shortage of childcare workers in this area, and the number of children on waiting lists is increasing.

notes:
A nationally licensed childcare professional who works at ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧ (nursery schools) or ⟦{認定|にんてい}→認定：06108_nintei⟧こども{園|えん} (certified children's centers). The qualification requires passing a national exam or graduating from a designated training program.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保育士|ほいくし}⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: nursery teacher qualification
- {保育士|ほいくし}⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧: shortage of childcare workers
- {保育士|ほいくし}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: nursery teacher exam
- {保育士|ほいくし}⟦{養成|ようせい}→養成：14655_yousei⟧: nursery teacher training

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧⟦{教諭|きょうゆ}→教諭：30765_kyouyu⟧: kindergarten teacher — works at kindergartens under the Ministry of Education, whereas {保育士|ほいくし} works at nursery schools under the Ministry of Health
- ⟦{保育|ほいく}→保育：11461_hoiku⟧⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: childcare provider — a more general term not tied to the specific national qualification
